The active source still omitted EMA, JPMA, and commercial, and retained vague element and terminology descriptions.

FHIR-31647 is background for the same associatedParty classifier element but concerned cardinality and party spelling; FHIR-32310 is same-change-family for value set link cleanup and already has a combined-branch audit commit; FHIR-37814 is a later associatedParty metadata cleanup and already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
